verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim best-in-class PBR, clustered lighting, a node-based material/shader editor and WebGL 1/2 plus WebGPU rendering backends, which covers the renderer core and materials. The pack says nothing about shadows, post-processing, or global illumination/baked lighting, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of shadow mapping, post-processing pipeline, global illumination or lightmap/baked lighting support, independent hands-on corroboration of render quality.
